hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; f=$(realpath "$f" 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; root=$(git -C "$(dirname "$f")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ -f "$root/plugins/gleaner/.claude-plugin/plugin.json" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in "$root"/.claude-plugin/*|"$root"/plugins/*) cd "$root" && { out=$(claude plugin validate . --strict 2>&1 && claude plugin validate ./plugins/gleaner --strict 2>&1) || { echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; }; } ;; esac
